note: Photographs taken out of rotation without moving a file. scripts/image-slot-manifest.mjs points every slot that holds a benched photograph at the picker's own week-collapse fallback (same folder, same time of day, week_1 slot 1 — step 2 of buildPickerPaths), so production serves that photograph instead and the benched bytes are not shipped. Only the built site is affected; an unbuilt local preview still reads the files. To un-bench, delete the entry. To move a photograph to another bucket, Al rules it on the page named in `ruling`.
